items.summary: After NTIA favored cheap satellite technology over fiber broadband, the BEAD fund of $42.5 billion was left with $21 billion in left-over monies.

items.title: T-Mobile CTO: AI is making disaster response faster, smarter
items.summary: T-Mobile CTO John Saw said AI is helping his network adapt faster when disasters strike so that customers will be able to use the network when they need it most.

items.title: Opinion: Huawei trial opens in Brooklyn as DOJ drops some charges
items.summary: Huawei's landmark RICO trial opens with the DOJ quietly trimming parts of its case, as a U.S. victory could disrupt communications and financial infrastructure across the developing world.

items.title: Elliott pushes Deutsche Telekom to prioritize buybacks over T-Mobile US mega-merger
items.summary: Elliott Investment Management is urging Germany’s Deutsche Telekom (DT) to back off a potential mega-merger plan with DT’s U.S.-based T-Mobile, according to reports.

items.title: T-Mobile taps former Shell CFO Jessica Uhl to help steer next phase of AI and enterprise growth
items.summary: Uhl's background in large-scale infrastructure investments, corporate development and AI initiatives could prove valuable as T-Mobile pursues opportunities across enterprise and emerging AI-driven services.

items.title: SK Telecom's AI model push offers a blueprint for telcos seeking sovereignty
items.summary: SK Telecom’s approach shows how telcos can use models to gain more control over AI deployments and put model ownership at the center of their AI strategy.
